newsitem.title: INDONESIA: Servitia 1996 net up, 1997 target revised.
newsitem.headline: Servitia 1996 net up, 1997 target revised.

text.p: Indonesia's PT Bank Umum Servitia said on Wednesday it posted a net profit of 18.415 billion rupiah in 1996, or up 95.87 percent from 1995.
It said in a statement that the bank has revised up its 1997 net profit forecast to 24 billion rupiah from the previous forecast of 22.656 billion rupiah.
"The firm revises up its 1997 net profit target from 22.656 billion rupiah to 24 billion rupiah," the statement said.
The bank said the revision was due to strong first quarter results.
Up to March 1997 the bank had met 28 percent of its previous projection for 1997 net profit, it said.
